<script>
const TEX="data:image/png;base64,",HM="data:image/png;base64,";
const el=document.getElementById('c'),r=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true,alpha:true});
r.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,2));r.outputEncoding=THREE.sRGBEncoding;el.appendChild(r.domElement);
const s=new THREE.Scene(),cam=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(35,1,.1,50);cam.position.set(0,0,5.2);
s.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff,.9));
const d=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,.9);d.position.set(2,3,4);s.add(d);
const d2=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,.4);d2.position.set(-3,-1,-3);s.add(d2);
const L=new THREE.TextureLoader(),t=L.load(TEX),hm=L.load(HM);t.encoding=THREE.sRGBEncoding;
t.anisotropy=r.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
const g=new THREE.Group();s.add(g);
const R=1.0,T=0.12;
function face(z,ry){const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2*R,2*R,400,400),
 new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({map:t,displacementMap:hm,displacementScale:.05,displacementBias:0,metalness:.55,roughness:.35,transparent:true,alphaTest:.5,side:THREE.FrontSide}));
 m.position.z=z;m.rotation.y=ry;g.add(m);}
face(T/2,0);face(-T/2,Math.PI);
const core=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(R*.985,R*.985,T,128,1,false),
 new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xd4a63a,metalness:1,roughness:.25}));
core.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;g.add(core);
const C=new THREE.OrbitControls(cam,r.domElement);C.enableDamping=true;C.autoRotate=true;C.autoRotateSpeed=1.5;C.enablePan=false;C.minDistance=2.5;C.maxDistance=9;
function rs(){const w=innerWidth,h=innerHeight;r.setSize(w,h);cam.aspect=w/h;cam.position.z=Math.max(cam.position.z,0);cam.updateProjectionMatrix()}
addEventListener('resize',rs);rs();
(function a(){requestAnimationFrame(a);C.update();r.render(s,cam)})();
